answer_summary: Tick (d): fully protonated PL1 forms the inverse hexagonal (H_II) phase. Protonation removes anionic head-group repulsion, reduces effective head area, and changes lamellar balanced packing to negative-curvature inverted packing.
assumptions: Problem input: physiological PL1 is the dianion and forms a lamellar phase.
Trusted general packing law: deprotonation adds a strictly positive electrostatic contribution to effective polar-head area; full protonation removes that contribution.

Qualitative phase geometry: balanced head/hydrophobic cross-sections correspond to zero-curvature lamellae, while a smaller head cross-section corresponds to negative curvature; among the printed choices only inverse hexagonal has negative curvature.
